[[Ambrillus the Guardian]] is one of the remaining Mursaat guiding the White Mantle, and is one of the four Mursaat giving commands back at the northern village of [[Demetra]]. [[Dinas]] reveals that he is [[Talios the Resplendent]]'s physician and appears with him during [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]].
